sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fmap over Nothing — applying a transformation to an absent value silently preserves the absence
sketches.resonance: No matter how you try to change someone who is gone, the absence is what persists.
sketches.draft:
transform :: Maybe a -> Maybe a
transform = fmap id

missing :: Maybe a
missing = Nothing

-- transform missing == Nothing

sketches.mechanism: Sending on a channel with no receiver blocks forever — a goroutine waiting indefinitely to give something away
sketches.resonance: An offering no one is there to receive becomes an eternal suspension, neither completed nor failed.

sketches.mechanism: Accessing any undefined variable returns nil rather than an error — the language treats the nonexistent as quietly present but empty
sketches.resonance: You can ask for anyone by name and Lua will answer calmly: nil — they were never here, and that is not an error.
